t_advice_summary_textbox.text: This person looked at the color schemes for the different gnomes and stuck with one until the results stopped being favorable. At that point, they switched to a different color scheme. They initially selected a color scheme by paying attention to the mushroom results.

vb_textbox.text: I saw eight different-colored gnomes in four pairs, but the pairs themselves stayed the same (for me it was red-vs.-yellow, green-vs.pink; never red-vs.-green or red-vs.pink). There will usually be one gnome with the larger amount of mushrooms. It's trial and error at first to figure out which gnome it is, and it CAN change (though for me it stayed constant for at least three or four appearances of a given pair). Also pay attention to the 5x multiplier when determining whether a gnome gives you lots of mushrooms or not—a yield of 5 is decent for a 1x multiplier, but if the multiplier is 5x it means the gnome only gives you 1 mushroom and you should probably try the other one.
